The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free; its intake line is open around the clock; it will visit clients in hospital or at home.

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

G1.source: the State Bar of California's licensee search
G1.evidence: 5 of 7 named attorneys hold an active California licence and none carries an adverse status. 2 name(s) could not be told apart from namesakes and are counted neither way

G2.source: the State Bar of California's licensee search
G2.evidence: No named attorney carries a disbarment, a suspension or a disciplinary resignation on the State Bar of California's record, across the 5 we identified. Administrative suspensions, which the State Bar states are non-disciplinary, are not counted here. The State Bar's record for Matt Faler carries an earlier entry, which is not outstanding against the licence today and is published in full at https://apps.calbar.ca.gov/attorney/Licensee/Detail/243067

G3.evidence: 2 physical locations verified on Google Business Profile. California publishes no business register we are able to query, so the registration itself is not verified here. The state's own business search is the place to check it.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 7 named attorneys published.
